name: hanyu-pinyin-extension
description: Local Chinese reading assistance for Chrome and Edge

scripts.run:chrome: npm run build && node scripts/run-extension.mjs --browser chrome
scripts.run:edge: npm run build && node scripts/run-extension.mjs --browser edge
scripts.run:chromium: npm run build && node scripts/run-extension.mjs --browser chromium
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run build:validate && npm run test:backend
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run store:generate && npm run store:validate && node scripts/package-release.mjs
scripts.store:release: npm run check && npm run store:generate && npm run store:validate && node scripts/package-release.mjs
